addClaims.text: New Xero apps default to the Starter tier with 5 connections.
addClaims.quote: New apps default to the starter tier with 5 connections.

addClaims.text: Moving to the Core tier allows up to 50 connections.
addClaims.quote: Moving up to Core will give you up to 50 connections.

addClaims.text: Listing on the Xero App Store requires the Plus tier or above.
addClaims.quote: To be listed on the App Store, you will need to be in the Plus tier or above.

addClaims.text: Monthly tier fees: Starter no charge, Core $35 AUD, Plus $245 AUD, Advanced $1445 AUD, Enterprise price on application.
addClaims.quote: Monthly Tier Fee No charge $35 AUD $245 AUD $1445 AUD Price on Application

addClaims.text: Maximum connections per tier: 5 / 50 / 1000 / 10,000 / no limit.
Certification matters beyond tiers: each Xero organisation can connect at most five uncertified apps, while certified apps have no such limit.
addClaims.quote: each organisation or practice is limited to connecting a maximum of five uncertified apps. There is no limit on connecting certified apps.

verdict.label: Full review
verdict.cost: Free for 5 connections; $35 AUD/mo for 50; certification + $245+ AUD/mo beyond
verdict.summary: Self-serve to create and test, but the free Starter tier caps you at 5 connected organisations; Core ($35 AUD/mo) allows 50, and anything beyond needs app certification and a security assessment.

addBlockers.symptom: The 6th customer can't connect their Xero organisation
addBlockers.fix: Upgrade the app to Core (up to 50 connections) in the Xero developer portal.
addBlockers.fallback: Disconnect unused/test tenants to free connections while you upgrade.
